generator.script: baselines/dplora/hybrid.py calibrate --eps E --sgd_share 0.3 --batch 1024 --epochs 3, then baselines/dplora/pipeline.py --variant vp --stage gpu --work <work> (calib.json in <work>) --batch 1024 --epochs 3 --lr 0.003 --rank 8 --clip 1.0 --coord_decimals 4 --decode repair --temperature 1.0 --top_p 1.0 --n_out 100000

_hybrid.run: scripts/run_hybrid.py --dataset D --eps E --work <work> --tag TAG + every non-underscore key as a flag (needs the v5 default-off flags --release_union_raw and --vote_cluster_kappa of scripts/run_pe.py / trajpe/pe.py / trajpe/v5.py, project code of 2026-10-24); OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS threads 4 as scripts/v4_job.sh (the release depends on the BLAS thread count). Evaluation-grid runs must export TRAJPE_GRID_NOMETRICS=1 and the snapshot must carry the NOMETRICS hook in BOTH scripts/run_pe.py (ported to the project 2026-10-24) and scripts/postprocess_release.py (only in the freeze-3 snapshot $TRAJPE_WORK/snapshots/trajpe_v4_20261022_r1); check one result.json for 'not computed (TRAJPE_GRID_NOMETRICS=1)' before queueing the grid

release_sidecar.writes: result.json 'hybrid': DP-SGD sigma, q, T, mu_PE spent, PLD eps_total at delta (recomputed)

_note: v5 = candidate P5b of the Jakarta v5 round (results/tuning/jakarta_v5.md, seed 0, 2026-10-24; plan and rule hashed in frozen/jakarta_v5_plan.sha256): v4 (= V0.3, configs/v4_large_eps.json) + release_union_raw 1 (the final pool fusion runs over the release-pool children UNION every untouched DP-model sample of the 100k pool) + vote_cluster_kappa 3 (SNR-matched cluster votes, K_t = clip(n_hat / (3 sigma_vote), 64, n_syn / 8)). n_syn 100000 and no pool refresh as v4. Generator, texts (100k), DP-SGD part and mu_PE unchanged (no new private statistic). Accepted by the pre-stated rule (a)-(f) and chosen by its choice rule: S 71 on Jakarta (next best P2 / P3 / P5 at 63, outside the <= 2 tie band), 75 on the fresh generator.
